name: resilio-sync
tagline: Unleash the power of seamless file synchronization.
description: resilio-sync is a Docker-based application that enables fast and secure file synchronization and sharing.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  resilio-sync:
    environment:
      - PGID=$PGID
      - PUID=$PUID
      - TZ=$TZ
    image: linuxserver/resilio-sync:3.1.2
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 55555
        published: "55555"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8888
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /sync
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
        target: /downloads
    privileged: false
    container_name: resilio-sync
